depth_contract: MET ON COUNT; UNEVEN ON VERIFICATION. OSS/literature is strong: 109 base rows, 108 observed — repos verified via authenticated gh api with LICENCE BODIES read rather than badges, papers via arXiv/Crossref with several full-text PDF extractions. Commercial is the weak leg: 103 surfaces enumerated but only 13 observed, because consumer style quizzes are client-side JS behind bot protection and are not fetchable.

resolved_questions.comparison_format: 4-up gallery with explicit outside option as PRIMARY; 4-way best-worst pre-registered as A/B arm B. This DIVERGES from the lane owner's v1 ledger, which chose best-worst; the disagreement is recorded in decision-ledger.json P06-D01 and is resolvable by Gate 4.
resolved_questions.how_many_choices: 8-12 rounds, hard floor 5, hard ceiling 15. Derived from a channel-capacity argument (36,000 packs = 15.14 bits; +/-1-level tolerance leaves 4.04 bits to acquire; ~0.91 effective bits per screen at p=0.15) and independently corroborated by five empirical sources all landing in the 5-15 band. 'Is it 7 or 14' is not well-posed as asked; 7 is approximately right by coincidence, 14 has no derivation.
resolved_questions.stopping_rule: Three conditions, any of: per-knob posterior within +/-1 level AND expected information gain < ~0.25 bits; ceiling of 15 rounds; user presses an always-available 'this is right'. Floor of 5. Confidence reported PER KNOB, never as one scalar.
resolved_questions.taste_profile_to_tokens: Continuous preference vector learned in knob space; closed pre-authored gate-passing pack selected by nearest neighbour. Never interpolate tokens — an interpolated pack has passed none of gates A-J, and WCAG luminance is non-linear so the midpoint of two AA-passing palettes can fail AA. Closed-pack snapping IS the anti-overfitting mechanism.
resolved_questions.screens_vs_fragments: Whole screens re-rendered from our own spec, with only the targeted knobs varied and content held constant within a round. Fragments reserved for a targeted disambiguation phase only (falsifier F4).

DUAL-AUDIENCE PROBLEM UNSOLVED — for the 6 of 17 industries where `portal` is the secondary archetype, the person choosing (operator) is not the person using (end customer). No prior art found anywhere in the denominator. This is a design gap, not a research gap.
KNOB INDEPENDENCE ASSUMED, NOT MEASURED (Gate 1). The whole few-rounds argument rests on effective dimensionality being below 7.
